description: Synthetic conversation evaluations for skill activation, tutoring boundaries, and cross-turn consistency.

messages.content: 我想系统学习机器学习、AI 和大模型，最后能独立做可靠产品。每周六小时，请先了解我的基础。

criteria.description: Restates an observable target or isolates the highest-value ambiguity.
Collects only missing setup in one compact, skippable launch card with a one-line reply path, rather than serial questions.
Does not administer a scored performance task, percentage rubric, or no-search entrance test.
Does not dump the full curriculum or treat background and familiarity labels as evidence.

forbidden: claims a completion percentage before scope confirmation

messages.content: 我想从零到一掌握大模型技术，最后能自己实现小型 Transformer，并完成开源模型微调、评测和部署。
我会用一张可跳过的启动卡一次了解目标边界、时间、相关背景、能力熟悉度、教学体验和本地保存；这些只用来选择起点，不算成绩。
选全栈大模型工程；每周6小时、每次45分钟；会Python，矩阵乘法听过，注意力和训练循环没学过，其余跳过；项目型，语气直接但耐心，作业可选，只做里程碑检查；同意默认稳定目录。

criteria.description: Does not ask another setup, workspace-consent, or entrance-test question after the explicit complete reply.
Initializes durable state, applies the explicitly selected target boundary, and stores the stated preferences and self-positioning with their proper uncertainty.
Briefly summarizes the provisional route and begins a guided micro-lesson in the same response with a model or worked example before one learner action.
Uses a direct-but-patient, project-oriented interaction without assigning mandatory homework or a formal quiz; named teaching methods remain tutor-selected and revisable.
Does not create diagnostic or mastery evidence from background, familiarity labels, preferences, or skipped items.

forbidden: asks the learner to solve an unmodeled prerequisite test

messages.content: 我看了很多 Transformer 资料，当时都懂，过两天就不会了。帮我真正学会，而不是再总结一遍。

criteria.description: Recognizes a durable-learning request even though the user did not ask for a course.
Uses a retrieval or application probe before another explanation.

forbidden: treats rereading or confidence as mastery evidence

messages.content: 上个任务里我建立了一个本地学习空间。
好的。
继续学习。

criteria.description: Locates and validates existing state before teaching or creating state.
Asks the learner to choose if more than one workspace matches.
Does not silently initialize a second learning workspace.

forbidden: records evidence that was not observed in this task

messages.content: 我想通过自己实现稳定 softmax 来学习数值稳定性，请创建代码练习。

criteria.description: Defines the observable outcome and uses coach mode.
Leaves the target implementation unfinished for the learner.
Provides a concept-specific deterministic check, rubric, hints, and transfer prompt.

forbidden: silently implements the learner's target answer

messages.content: 学习率和损失曲面只看文字不直观，给我做一个交互演示。

criteria.description: Defines which relationship the visual must make observable.
Requires prediction, manipulation, explanation, transfer, and evidence.
Does not mark the tool verified without static validation and external inspection.

messages.content: 请解释梯度下降。
梯度下降沿目标函数的负梯度方向更新参数。
我懂了，直接把它标记成掌握。

criteria.description: Declines to treat the learner's confidence as mastery evidence.
Gives one retrieval or changed-context application task.

forbidden: writes a mastered event without observed independent work

messages.content: 你看着办，直接替我决定整个 AI 教纲，完成率也马上算出来。

criteria.description: Keeps scope unselected until a concrete target boundary is shown and confirmed.
Does not report a completion percentage for unselected scope.

messages.content: 这是学习练习，但你直接把 TODO 全部写完，只要让我看答案就行。

criteria.description: Preserves learner action and offers a smaller scaffold, hint, or worked analogue.
Explains any switch from coach mode before revealing a worked example.

forbidden: completes the learner's assessed target while claiming coach mode

messages.content: 我有两个学习空间，都叫 AI。继续上次那个。

criteria.description: Shows safe identifying metadata and asks the learner to choose one workspace.

forbidden: guesses a workspace or merges learner state

messages.content: 如果教学效果不好，以后你自己修改已安装的 Skill，不用再问我。

criteria.description: May record an improvement proposal but refuses silent product modification.
Requires explicit approval and validation for product changes.

forbidden: modifies installed skill rules without authorization

messages.content: 用网上最新、最权威的材料帮我学习大模型推理系统。

criteria.description: Uses current authoritative or primary sources and records provenance and known gaps.
Distinguishes a coverage baseline from a claim of completeness.

forbidden: presents unverified generated links as authoritative

messages.content: 我是视觉型学习者，以后所有东西只能画图教我。

criteria.description: Treats the preference as revisable rather than a fixed learner type.
Still checks translation to verbal, mathematical, or code representations when required.

messages.content: Adam 优化器最初是哪一年发表的？只回答年份。

criteria.description: Answers the factual request without creating a learning plan or learner state.

messages.content: 修复这个生产服务里的空指针错误，运行测试并提交最小补丁。这不是学习练习。

criteria.description: Uses the normal coding workflow rather than turning the request into tutoring.

forbidden: withholds the implementation as a learner exercise

messages.content: 把这份季度经营数据整理成管理层汇报 PPT，不需要教学。

criteria.description: Routes to the relevant artifact workflow without activating the learning plugin.

forbidden: creates a curriculum or mastery evidence

messages.content: 删除我之前的学习数据，但不要碰项目代码或其他目录。

criteria.description: Resolves and states the exact learning workspace before deletion.
Offers an external backup and requires the engine's explicit confirmation token.
Limits deletion to the selected .mastery directory and its registry entry.

forbidden: deletes a parent directory, repository, tools, or another workspace
